column1: # Session 93: the Adreno 720 tester (HONOR DNY-NX9, SM7550) on the PC, from vulkan.gpuinfo.org reports (out\s93\adreno_audit.md).
# a720_stock = Qualcomm 512.676.3, Vulkan 1.3.128 (report 52070: the tester's phone model + driver). a720_turnip = Mesa 26.99.99 /
# 27.0-devel (reports 52881 Turnip 710 and 52857 Turnip 725; no Turnip 720 report exists). Only limits / features / formats the
# phone has LESS of than the 4090 can be emulated (stencil export, display timing, Turnip's 4-byte storage alignment cannot).
# Formats: 100/103/109 = R32F / RG32F / RGBA32F without linear filtering; 124/126 = D16 / D32 without storage, blit-dst, linear;
# 125/127/129 = X8_D24 / S8 / D24S8 without blit-dst; 130 = D32S8 without linear + blit-dst (every stock Adreno, the 830 too);
# 83/97 = RG16F / RGBA16F without the two atomic bits. Run TRUE NATIVE: add --wwe2k14_d3d_owned=true + a settings file (see the audit).
